Whole-package acceptance distinguishes unbound, mismatch and missing retained evidence and compares authored binding to actual retained carrier; never fill absence implicitly. Provide INITIAL binding preparation for unbound legacy: verify old pin/manifest/cited bytes against actual retained capture then propose selected hash, without circular need for already whole-package AcceptedOrigin. Any bound origin uses explicit distinct bound-intent recipe/domain retained in IntentIdentity and per-origin presence/hash frames; incremental binding does not claim unbound origins accepted. Work recipes unchanged. New parser accepts old syntax; older parser refuses unknown new field, report non-bidirectional compatibility. No forced migrations, parallel world, new store/security.
Required C1 regressions: exact legacy v1 vectors; ONLY uncited package content changes => drift, empty selected-fact delta, new authored binding and changed bound intent after explicit rebase; unbound/mismatch refusals and explicit initial binding/comment preservation; serialized binding with lost carrier remains unavailable. Hash is a selection declaration, not authentication or historical-byte recovery. Keep original C1 cases. No new campaign task.

question.title: C1 authored accepted package-content binding
question.introductionMarkdown: Current core schema1 origins store exact pin+manifest/document SHA, but no selected package ContentHash. The retained carrier now preserves that independent selected identity. Source counterexample: selected package content changes outside those leaves; comparison reports drift, yet explicit rebase would produce identical authored origin tokens/intent because source ContentHash is not represented.

items.promptMarkdown: Choose exact owner correction for storing accepted selected content identity in authored intent: grant minimal additive optional binding in core change Wire/validation/identity and actual registered change-manifest schema/generated contract (name exact paths), with old unbound schema1 hashes/compatibility preserved and explicit unavailable content binding; or confirm deliberate leaf-only authored scope and that selected ContentHash remains separately held/report-only, without claiming full package-content binding in intent. No editable hash will authenticate originals.
items.contextMarkdown: C1 step1 says store accepted identity in authored change intent; existing B1/B2 shape cannot persist selected whole-package ContentHash. An opaque metadata field cannot fix this because B2 excludes metadata from intent. Avoid silent recipe/schema meaning change or a second source store. Remaining actual saved/refusal tests can continue at current subject while Root decides.

options.label: Add exact authored binding

options.label: Explicit leaf-only intent
options.description: Keep current schema; source ContentHash is held/report-only and cannot be claimed as authored intent binding.
